name: Digages Website Monitor
author: Digages

sections.description:
Digages Website Monitor is a lightweight security and activity monitoring plugin designed to help site owners understand what’s happening on their WordPress website and respond quickly to potential threats.

The plugin tracks visitor activity and time spent on the site, monitors login attempts with optional limits to reduce brute-force attacks, and watches for plugin installations and updates that may affect site security.

Admins can receive email notifications whenever plugins are installed or updated, helping detect unauthorised changes early and maintain full control of the website environment.

Digages Website Monitor focuses on essential monitoring features without unnecessary complexity or performance overhead.

Why Digages Website Monitor?

Keeping your WordPress site secure can be challenging. Digages Website Monitor gives you peace of mind by providing clear insights into visitor activity, monitoring login attempts, and alerting you to theme or plugin changes. You’ll know immediately if anything unusual happens, allowing you to act fast and protect your site.

Features:

  • Track visitor activity and time on site

  • Monitor and limit failed login attempts

  • Detect theme and plugin installs and updates

  • Send email alerts to admins for installs and updates

  • Lightweight and performance-friendly

Other Plugins by Digages:

  • Direct Payments for WooCommerce

  • Direct Payments WP

  • SVG Editor: Upload & Change Colors

  • APL – Auto-Pickup Locations for WooCommerce

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide certain features. These services are optional and can be disabled where applicable.

  1. Digages API

This service is used to validate plugin activation and assist with update and licensing checks.

  • When data is sent: During plugin activation and when checking plugin status.
  • Data sent: Site URL, plugin version, and activation status.
  • Service provider: Digages
  • Terms of Service: https://digages.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://digages.com/privacy
  1. IP-API

This service is used to determine the approximate country and city of site visitors based on their IP address. This helps administrators understand visitor locations. This feature can be disabled in the plugin settings.

  • When data is sent: When visitor activity tracking is enabled.
  • Data sent: Visitor IP address.
  • Service provider: IP-API
  • Terms of Service: https://ip-api.com/docs/legal
  • Privacy Policy: https://ip-api.com/docs/legal
sections.installation:
Using The WordPress Dashboard:

  • Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New Plugin from the left-hand menu.
  • In the search box, type Digages Website Monitor by Digages.
  • Click on Install Now when you see the Digages Website Monitor.
  • After installation, click Activate
sections.faq:
Does it track logged‑in users only or all visitors?

Yes, It tracks both guest and logged‑in users.

Will I receive emails for every theme or plugin update?

Yes. Admins can choose to be notified whenever a theme or plugin is installed or updated so you can quickly review changes.

Can I limit failed login attempts?

Yes. The plugin includes login attempt monitoring and optional limits to help prevent brute‑force attacks.

Does it store sensitive user data?

No sensitive personal data is collected. The plugin focuses on activity events and security‑related actions.

Does this plugin slow down my website?

No. Digages Website Monitor is built to be lightweight and only records essential activity to minimize performance impact.
